_comment: Data file for scripts/ai-cost-model.ts. Every number here traces to AI-COST-AUDIT-1 (AI-COST-AUDIT-REPORT.md, repo root) plus AI-COST-2 (the follow-up implementation sprint). Update this file (add a job / adjust an estimate) whenever a sprint adds or changes an LLM call, per the CLAUDE.md process rule. Fields 'alwaysApplyBatch' / 'alwaysApplyDeltaGate' on a job, and 'shippedAsOfAiCost2' on an estimatedComponent, mean that job/component's optimization is REAL and shipped (applied in EVERY scenario), not merely modeled in the waste_gated scenario.

claude-opus-4-5-20251101.source: src/lib/aria/cost.ts (canonical) -- NOTE base-agent.ts uses $15/$75 for the same model, disagreement flagged in report section 1, not used here

gpt-4o-mini.source: ASSUMED -- not present in src/lib/aria/cost.ts PRICING table at all; this is OpenAI's published gpt-4o-mini rate, not a codebase constant

batchDiscountSource: AI-COST-2: now a real exported constant, src/lib/aria/cost.ts BATCH_DISCOUNT_FACTOR (0.5), used by computeBatchCostCents(). Anthropic's publicly documented Batch API discount (50% off input+output), applied uniformly.

measuredJobs.label: Hypothesis engine
measuredJobs.trigger: cron h15 batch-submit / h03 batch-poll (AI-COST-2: converted to Batch API)

measuredJobs.label: BAS compliance monitor
measuredJobs.batchConversionDeferred: AI-COST-2 scoped the full batch conversion to hypothesis_engine only (cleanest single-call/non-chained candidate, and the audit's own featured waste example). bas_compliance/clv/inventory_financing/weekly_promos remain realtime pending a follow-up sprint -- see AI-COST-2 commit message.

measuredJobs.label: Customer lifetime value
measuredJobs.batchConversionDeferred: see bas_compliance note -- also has a multi-step claudeStructured+claudeReason chain in customer-acquisition-agent.ts, architecturally harder to batch safely

measuredJobs.label: Anomaly-synth (Gemini, not Anthropic)
measuredJobs.trigger: cron h03 daily, gated on new signals

estimatedComponents.label: business-brain analyse() via model-router.ts
estimatedComponents.wasteGatedNote: AI-COST-2 SHIPPED: model-router.ts now logs every call to aria_ai_calls (closing the blind spot the 0.20-0.50 estimate existed to bound), and business-brain.ts now has a real 60-min TTL cache keyed (business_id, mode) with an explicit bypass for owner-initiated refresh (business_brain_cache table). 0.15/day is this sprint's modeled expected value for the cached architecture -- will be superseded by real aria_ai_calls data once this has run in production for a few days.
estimatedComponents.basis: 15-25K input tokens/call (compactData payload), 800 max output tokens, haiku rate, assumed 5-30 calls/day pre-cache. No logged data existed to pin this down more precisely before AI-COST-2 (model-router.ts had zero cost-tracking) -- see AI-COST-AUDIT-REPORT.md section 4.

estimatedComponents.label: Cron-driven spend for ~16 other businesses that existed during the audit window and were hard-deleted (with their aria_ai_calls rows) by migration 20260709000001, 4 days before this audit ran
estimatedComponents.basis: Lower bound: 15 x Sip's own measured cron-only (non-chat) total (~$0.15/15days). Unrecoverable from the DB -- report section 2.4/4. Historical-window-only; excluded from forward-looking projections since it reflects deleted dev/test fixtures, not real customers.

estimatedComponents.label: Daily-briefing Batch API cost for the 16 business-slots/day observed in aria_batch_jobs during the window (no cost column exists on that table)
estimatedComponents.basis: 240 requests (16 businesses x 15 days), ~300 input + ~200 output tokens/request, haiku batch rate. Report section 2.4/4. Historical-window-only.

nonAiCosts.label: SMS (ClickSend)
nonAiCosts.basis: COST-LEDGER-1: no real cost_events volume history exists yet (instrumentation just shipped this sprint). Placeholder ESTIMATE: ~1 SMS/business/day (reminders, OTP, staff/owner alerts) x CLICKSEND_RATE_AUD_CENTS(8) x USD_PER_AUD(0.66) -- see src/lib/clicksend.ts. Replace with a real average once cost_events has a few weeks of production data.

nonAiCosts.label: Email (Resend)
nonAiCosts.basis: $0 while inside the Resend free tier (RESEND_MONTHLY_QUOTA, src/lib/external-apis.ts). The real cost event is the forced plan upgrade once volume crosses the quota -- aria-health-monitor alerts at 80% BEFORE that happens, it doesn't show up here as a $ figure until the plan actually changes.

nonAiCosts.label: Stripe processing fees (subscription billing)
nonAiCosts.basis: COST-LEDGER-1: no real cost_events volume history exists yet (charge.succeeded handler + backfill just shipped this sprint). Placeholder ESTIMATE: one subscription charge/business/month at Stripe's standard 2.9%+$0.30 rate against a representative ~$85 USD-equivalent plan price, spread over 30 days ((85*0.029+0.30)/30). Replace with a real average once cost_events has a few billing cycles of production data. NOTE: this is OUR Stripe fee for collecting a business's subscription payment -- NOT that business's own POS transaction fees, which are a business-side cost, not ours.
